notes.title: Welcome to the future: One Last Job is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
One Last Job, Null State, and Another Round are now available for purchase on Steam!

One Last Job is a team management game that plays like a puppet theatre: you pick the scene, the crew, then laugh and cheer as they fail (and succeed!) at their jobs.

Null State is a loveletter to 90s CRPGs, with weird NPCs, their (disturbing) cyberpunk stories, and Battleship-style (seek-and-destroy) IC-breaking combat in corpo nets. Another Round is a low-stress deckbuilding game about having a good time... where the main loop is making three-card combos and its most important resource is VIBE.

All three games are also available together in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41204/The_Null_State_Franchise/]the Null State Franchise bundle[/url] -- at a pretty good discount, too!

notes.title: Play the demo for One Last Job during Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is a multi-day celebration of upcoming games -- and what better place to celebrate the overwhelming authority of modern-day megacorps than here! With your Steam friends! Together... all in one place... where Valve can keep an eye on you...

These demos -- all set in the same near-future, cyberpunk universe -- introduce you to the characters and circumstances of the Null State universe.

In One Last Job, you'll start your journey to becoming the most famous fixer in the world -- by taking your first steps managing a street-level crew.

You'll get around 20 minutes of playtime in this demo, to give you a taste of what One Last Job is all about. Try to enjoy this caricature of our (inevitable?) near-future dystopia.

If you run across any bugs, or have any sugggestions, please drop into the relevant Discussions thread to let us know!
